exact_statement: For every indicator g with actual connected components g_k and a component-isolating physical block A, raw bit Fourier entropy satisfies F(g)<=sum_k F(g_k)+Gamma_A, with Gamma_A=[B_A(g)+(2/ln2)E_A(g)-sum_k Lambda_A(g_k)]_+, B_A the mass-weighted conditional selector spectral entropy and Lambda_A=B_A+(1/ln2)sum_t Ent(v_t^2). If a proper block A of size r has components R_k x V_k with disjoint subcube selectors R_k fixing d_k>=r/2 coordinates, then Lambda_A(g_k)=2d_k M(g_k)=4E_A(g_k), Gamma_A<=(2/ln2)E_A(g), and Rraw(g)<=max_k Rraw(g_k)+(2/ln2)E_A(g)/E(g). If all proper physical indicator restrictions have ratio at most Rraw(g), then Rraw(g)<=4+2/ln2. For the actual sign f=1-2g, if all proper physical restrictions have ratio at most H(f)/I(f) and M(g)>=p0>0, then H(f)/I(f)<=2/ln2+1/p0. Threshold-critical signs with positive H-KI and nonpositive proper-child deficits are excluded at K>=2/ln2+1/p0. Universal separator or density admission is not asserted.
hypotheses: Finite uniform cube; all new entropies in bits; raw indicator energy E differs from sign influence I=4E
Component-isolating means each physical A-fiber meets at most one actual connected component
Thin-cylinder payment requires actual components with disjoint subcube selectors fixing at least half the block coordinates and connected nonempty data supports
Critical conclusions require a proper nonempty selector block and the stated all-proper-physical-restriction comparison; positive energies for ratios
Sign critical bound additionally requires support mass M(g)>=fixed p0>0; no inherited child criticality or universal class admission
